northReview: coverage_contract: independent read-only review before construction
boundaryPolicy: Terrain-derived named coastal side with 24 metre shoulder transition; no rectangular planting feather. All four census edges must exclude selected component; enlarge scan otherwise.
scopePolicy: All admitted components intersecting established coastal and two foothill seed regions. Include LOWLAND soil. Record excluded components. Census limits are computational only.
targetPolicy: max(existing occupancy, deterministic terrain quota). Never lower quota to fit memory.
cellPolicy: 1 metre cells; independently test 4x4 interior probes. Fully eligible cells must meet quota. Boundary shortfalls require counted eligible probes and actual rejected-candidate reasons.
runtimePolicy: Preserve all visible roots; conservative frustum rejection only. Record combined saved/runtime roots, allocated bytes, visible roots, submitted triangles, draw calls and uploads separately. Any larger resident allocation requires measured exact-candidate runtime evidence.
